recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce coordinateType or duplicate the grouped Confluence wording; the authoritative StructureDefinition and notes already carry the approved semantics and later clarifications.
issue_request: FHIR-37409 was a Published FHIR-core ImagingSelection change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to clarify how ImageRegion coordinates relate to Frame of Reference and selected instances. The accepted resolution was to apply the grouped IMIN Confluence updates for FHIR-36648, FHIR-36649, and FHIR-37409.
initial_application: Commit 5c5a620527e102650cad53df57ff594d1706fe2a, later merged by 471fbc468b8fd5427fcebad076569e16590ac707, applied the grouped ImagingSelection update. It split 2D image-region coordinates under ImagingSelection.instance, kept 3D image regions at resource level, removed coordinateType, and updated examples, terminology, and notes.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in source/fhir.ini. Later ImagingSelection work did not reverse the seed decision: FHIR-48101 added invariants for seriesUid, instance, frameOfReferenceUid, imageRegion3D, and 2D/3D mutual exclusion, while FHIR-51645 later adjusted coordinate element minimums back to 1 but retained explicit multiple-of-two and multiple-of-three constraints.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source already has imageRegion3D requiring frameOfReferenceUid, mutual exclusion between imageRegion3D and instance.imageRegion2D, 2D coordinates defined in pixel space, 3D coordinates defined in the Frame of Reference coordinate system, and coordinate-count constraints.
